description: The company numbers behind one Robinhood Stock Token on Robinhood Chain, from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings, by ticker (AAPL) or token contract: revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS (diluted and basic), operating cash flow, capital expenditure and free cash flow for TTM (four contiguous quarters, "TTM to <end>"), the last 4 fiscal years or the last 8 quarters (period: ttm, annual or quarterly); margins; year-on-year growth; the latest balance sheet; shares outstanding with its date; the last 8 quarters of revenue and diluted EPS with YoY; and market cap and P/E at the Chainlink reference only when one share count, the multiplier and a current reference allow it (otherwise the reason). Values a filing does not state are labelled derived; EPS is never added up across quarters. Funds and foreign filers say so. Facts, not advice.

id.description: A stock ticker as Robinhood lists it (AAPL, NVDA, BRK.B) or the Stock Token's contract on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex)

period.description: ttm (default): the last four quarters; annual: the last 4 fiscal years; quarterly: the last 8 quarters

title: Company fundamentals
